richiami.difetto: The products pose a risk of fire in the case of a short-circuit on the printed circuit board for the heating system for windscreen washer fluid.  In the vehicles concerned, the ground lead of the control circuit may overheat and cause other electrical systems to malfunction and produce smells and smoke. In extreme cases the vehicle could catch fire.
